title: Tamsin and the Echo
author: Coral Vane
blurb: Ada Quintana, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
